description.en-US:
SG (Sawa Gaadi) is Nepal's driver-bidding ride-sharing platform — fast, fair, and built for Kathmandu.

RIDERS:
• Enter your destination and watch multiple drivers bid for your ride
• See real-time driver location on a live map
• Pay through your SG wallet (eSewa / Khalti top-up)
• Rate your driver and build a better community

DRIVERS:
• Set your own price by bidding on nearby ride requests
• Earn more with a higher safety score and badge tier
• Background GPS updates keep your position accurate even when the screen is off
• Get instant push notifications for new ride requests

FEATURES:
• Real-time bidding — no surge pricing surprises
• Live map tracking during every ride
• Multi-stop trips supported
• Full wallet: top-up, payout, transaction history
• OTP-based login — no passwords needed
• Available in Kathmandu, Lalitpur, and Bhaktapur

releaseNotes.en-US: Initial release of SG — ride-sharing with driver bidding for Nepal.
